newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali to move into Slovenian market.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali to move into Slovenian market.

text.p: Austrian insurer EA-Generali AG said on Thursday it would enter the market in neighbouring Slovenia next year as leader of a Ljubljana-based joint venture Ljubljanska zavarovalnica (LZ).
EA-Generali said it and its subsidiary Interunfall Versicherung AG had taken a 50 percent stake in LZ. Slovenia's SKB Banka holds the remaining 50 percent.
Slovenia's finance ministry had already approved the deal, EA-Generali said in a statement.
EA-Generali said the joint venture would initially focus on selling life and accident insurance through SKB Banka branches.
LZ would later expand into other areas and set up its own insurance network, including agents, it continued. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
